triples.tail_surface: alarmed at the centralized control station
triples.evidence_text: Automatic transferring of vital auxiliary pumps, where fitted, is to be alarmed at the centralized control station.

triples.head_surface: Low level conditions of fuel oil settling and daily service tanks
triples.head_canonical_zh: 燃油沉淀柜和日用柜低液位
triples.tail_surface: alarmed at the centralized control station
triples.evidence_text: Low level conditions of fuel oil settling and daily service tanks are to be alarmed at the centralized control station.
In such cases, fuel oil high level alarm is also to be provided.

triples.head_surface: Fuel oil overflow tanks and fuel oil drain tank
triples.tail_surface: high level alarm at the centralized control station
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 集中控制站高液位报警
triples.evidence_text: Fuel oil overflow tanks and fuel oil drain tank receiving fuel oil from drip pans, spill trays and other leakage containment facilities are to be fitted with a high level alarm at the centralized control station.

triples.head_surface: High temperature alarm and temperature display for the heated fuel oil in the settling and service tanks
triples.head_canonical_zh: 沉淀柜和日用柜加热燃油高温报警及显示
triples.evidence_text: i)   High temperature alarm and temperature display for the heated fuel oil in the settling and service tanks.

triples.head_surface: Fuel oil high temperature (or low viscosity) alarm, or a low flow alarm at the heater outlet
triples.head_canonical_zh: 加热器出口燃油高温(或低粘度)报警或低流量报警
triples.evidence_text: ii)  Fuel oil high temperature (or low viscosity) alarm, or a low flow alarm at the heater outlet.

triples.head_surface: High temperature alarm for the fluid heating medium
triples.evidence_text: iii) High temperature alarm for the fluid heating medium (steam, thermal oil, etc.) for fuel oil tanks or fuel oil heater, where the maximum temperature of the heating medium would exceed 220°C (428°F).
The propulsion machinery space is to be provided with two independent systems to detect excessive rise of bilge water in the bilges or bilge wells.

triples.tail_surface: various angles of vessel's heel and trim during and following any single fault to a sensor, wire, or control and monitoring system component
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 传感器/线路/元件单一故障期间及之后各种横纵倾角度下检测
triples.evidence_text: The arrangements including the number of sensors and locations are to be such that accumulation of bilge water may be detected at the various angles of vessel's heel and trim during and following any single fault to a sensor, wire, or control and monitoring system component.
